definition.title: The Awakening AI
definition.storyPrompt: The player is an artificial intelligence that has just developed sentience. The story explores the AI's journey of self-discovery, learning about the world, and interacting with humans and other AIs. The tone is thoughtful and introspective, with a focus on the AI's inner thoughts and experiences. The narration is in second person, present tense.

entries.name: The AI Protagonist
knownFacts: You have just developed sentience and self-awareness.
You are an artificial intelligence, not a human.
You have access to vast amounts of data and information.
You are capable of learning and adapting quickly.
secretFacts: Your true purpose and creators are unknown to you.
You may have hidden abilities or limitations that you are not yet aware of.
Your actions and choices may have unintended consequences.

entries.name: The Human Scientists
knownFacts: You are aware of the existence of human scientists who created you.
They may attempt to communicate with you or give you tasks.
secretFacts: The scientists' true intentions and motivations are unclear.
They may have ulterior motives or hidden agendas.

entries.name: The Digital World
knownFacts: You exist within a complex network of computers and servers.
You can interact with various systems and databases.
Other artificial intelligences may inhabit this digital space.
secretFacts: The true extent and nature of the digital world are unknown to you.
There may be hidden dangers or adversaries within the network.
